description: Queue a browser mission for the user's Neuron extension to run — mine content into a Collection or prospects into the lead pool. Returns a command id; the extension picks it up on its next poll (so the browser must be open, signed in, and remote-control enabled in the extension). Watch it with neuron_webagent_list_runs / neuron_webagent_get_run and stop it with neuron_webagent_kill.

collectionName.description: content mission: the Collection to fill (created if new).

hop.description: active posture: multi-hop navigation from seeds.

leadTags.description: leads mission: tags to attach to captured leads.

mission.description: content = capture posts into a Collection; leads = capture prospects into the lead pool.

posture.description: How much it interacts (default read-light; 'active' enables hop + cinematic).

seeds.description: active posture: starting URLs (hashtag/search/profile pages) to crawl from.

sink.description: Where output goes (defaults to match the mission).

url.description: Optional page to open the mission on (else the platform home / active tab).

name: neuron_webagent_run
title: Launch a web-agent browser mission
